title: WireSketch assembly description
description: PCB instances, interface-to-interface connections, pin mappings, and diagram layout.

schema.description: Stable format identifier. Never translate or modify it.

nodes.description: Board instances. Multiple nodes may reference the same boardId.

connections.description: Directed records used to define endpoint and pin-map orientation; electrical flow may still be bidirectional.

embeddedBoards.description: Self-contained PCB definitions referenced by nodes[].boardId. Include each board definition once.

routing.description: hybrid prefers clear diagonal wire bundles and falls back to obstacle-avoiding orthogonal routes.

id.description: Unique instance ID inside this assembly.

boardId.description: References embeddedBoards[].id, not another node ID.

label.description: Instance label; it may differ from the board definition name.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation of this PCB instance. Omitted values are treated as 0 for backward compatibility.

flipX.description: Mirrors this PCB instance horizontally in its local, unrotated coordinate system.

scale.description: Visual scale of this PCB instance. Image, interfaces, pins, routing anchors, and export output scale together.

interfaceId.description: References the selected node's PCB interfaces[].id.

from.description: 1-based physical pin number on the from endpoint.

to.description: 1-based physical pin number on the to endpoint.

pinMap.description: Explicit 1-based wire mapping. An empty array means the connection exists but its physical wiring is unspecified.
